situations.headline: VMC: $35.15m special cash dividend post Youanmi royalty sale, paid 18-Sep-2026

changelog.entry: stage-2 assessment: VMC: $35.15m special cash dividend post Youanmi royalty sale, paid 18-Sep-2026 (interest 6, risk 4)

thesis.text: Venus is a serial asset-recycler funding shareholder distributions via opportunistic sales (Youanmi royalty at ~98% gross margin) while retaining a diversified WA exploration portfolio (Sandstone, Henderson, Bridgetown-Greenbushes JV) and a residual Rox Resources stake. Near-term catalyst is the 18-Sep-2026 cash special dividend payment; longer-term value depends on strategic review outcomes and exploration drill results at Sandstone/Henderson. Governance risk is elevated given a recent hostile takeover attempt and a live spill-resolution contingency, warranting continued monitoring of AGM/remuneration and further portfolio monetisation announcements.
